name: email-himalaya
description: External email provider: implements email@1 on top of the himalaya mail CLI (multiple accounts, a configurable default account, verification-code extraction through the definition)

config.description: No `accounts` is a valid state: the plugin then loads and reports 'not configured' without registering the provider.

defaultAccount.description: Account label used when a call passes no account; default: the first configured account

accounts.description: Accounts by label: { address?, accountName?, credential?, folder? }. `accountName` is the account name in himalaya's own config (default: the label); `credential` is a credential NAME resolved at call time, never a value

binary.description: himalaya executable, resolved on PATH by default

maxOutputBytes.description: Cap of one command's output in bytes
